name: Dagger: Kijin no Kyouji
source:
4th in the DAGGER series. As a servant of Farna, Tisto sees how the aristocratic 
society goes on. Preparation for incoming assault is set while chasing after one's dream.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE231373.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
DAGGER系列第四弹。作为法尔纳的仆人，蒂斯托看到贵族如何 
社会还在继续。在追逐梦想的同时，也做好了应对突袭的准备。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE231373.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
